about.title: About the championship
about.text: Beauty Dynastya is an international online competition for beauty masters. Compete from your own studio, anywhere in the world — your work is evaluated by an international jury of leading industry professionals.
about.joinDescription: Become a participant, judge or speaker at Beauty Dynastya. Choose your role and apply.

alexandra-andreea.bio: Lash artist with 5 years in the UK, founder of the ZeroGravity Concept and NikolaLash Academy. Judge at Lash Global Dubai and Mondial Beauty Championship. Presented by Beauty Panda.

marzena-laskowska.bio: Lash artist, junior judge and independent beauty trainer. 4 trophies at live lash championships: 3 silver, 1 bronze. Presented by Beauty Panda.

letizia-barone.bio: Lashmaker since 2018, educator for Sopracciglieria Italiana. International podiums in extensions, lamination and henna. 2026 International Beauty Awards: Top Lami Trainer and Rising Star in the Lash Industry; opened her own academy the same year.

tsveti-ivanova.bio: Certified lash artist and founder of Cffety Lashes. Classic, hybrid, volume, wispy, anime and custom lash styling.

giulia-mascolo.bio: Lash artist and trainer since 2020. Lash & brow lamination, Korean Lash Lift. Award-winning competitor.

daniela-ndreu.bio: Master educator at a leading Italian lash extension academy, international judge and champion of several lash competitions.

diana-caprar.bio: 6+ years in the field and a trainer for 2+ years with over 300 students.

annalisa-milano.bio: Lash lifting and extensions. 1st place junior at WBC Beauty Champ and LamiDay Rome, 2nd place junior at the European Lash Championship.

yulia-shepel.bio: International lash judge, award-winning lash artist and educator.

silvia-sicuro.bio: Lash artist and trainer with 11 years of experience. Two podium placements in lash competitions.

alina-brikuna.bio: Lash artist with 4 years of experience. Lash Diva Championship 2026 (Riga): 1st place volume 2D–3D, 2nd place classic. Wink of Beauty: two 3rd places.

shiran-shalom.bio: PMU artist specialising in the ombré technique. Trained in Israel, Ukraine and Belgium; teaches lip PMU.

katy-pinchasov.bio: Owner of a private clinic in Sderot. Brows, lips and eyes; PMU and tattoo removal, microneedling.

zofiya-yadayi.bio: Brows, lips, eyes and tattoos; runs advanced courses. Multiple 1st places for eyeliner, lips and brow cover-up (2025–2026).

celine-vermeille.bio: Tattoo and PMU artist, founder of Dahlia Studio. Hairstroke brows, fine-line and scar tattooing, 3D areola reconstruction. 1st places in 3D Areola Reconstruction and Fine Line Tattoo.

marzena-guenther.bio: In beauty since 2004, PMU since 2017, certified Linergist. Grand Prix and two Polish Champion titles at PMU Gold Championship 2026. Judge at Amber Eyes, PMU Indonesia and Worlds Poland 2026.

angelica-betancourt.bio: Founder of Angelica Nails Academy, 10+ years in the nail industry, mentored 100+ nail artists. Nail reconstruction and architecture: gel, acrylic, acrygel, airbrush, nail art.

angela-betancourt.bio: Nail trainer & educator with 10+ years of experience, co-founder of Angelica Nails Academy, branding trainer and content creator.

anna-barnakova.bio: International nail trainer and owner of a nail salon in Michalovce. Winner of the Top 10 Nail Artist title and the Top Nail Trainer award.

julia-beauty.bio: World Champion 2025 (thin hair, Hair Extensions Guru Championship), IBA Beauty Awards XIII laureate, IBIA Level 5 international judge. Founder of Julia Beauty Academy and author of The 3D Layers Capsules Method™.

andreea-bisericaru.bio: Lash trainer and international judge, working in eyelash extensions since 2018.

gina-paans.bio: Beauty professional with over 10 years of experience and a specialist in Korean Lash Lift. She won four awards in Belgium and Barcelona.

elinor-beladev.bio: Israeli artist and educator with nearly a decade of experience in brows and permanent makeup. Her work includes natural brow design and restoration, microblading, powder shading and laser removal of permanent makeup.

manuela-stefancu.bio: Lash artist, trainer and demonstrator with nine years of experience in eyelash extensions. She develops techniques for custom lash designs, including wearable extensions for men.

katarzyna-stefanowicz.bio: Founder of KASICA STUDIO PMU in Poland and international permanent makeup trainer. Silver medallist in HairStrokes at WULOP Austria 2022, judge at WULOP Azerbaijan 2024 and PEINTO ambassador. Creator of the Velvet Eyeshadow and Combibrows techniques.

silvia-amadei-lash.bio: Master Trainer since 2024, founder of SA Academy Lash & Brows and creator of FOXYLAMI, a Korean lash lift technique. Brand partner of AURAMONACO and PURPLE Flame Cosmetics. She has judged at Roma World Beauty 2026 and other international lash championships.

simona-nardella.bio: Lash and lamination artist since 2024 and master at Lash Love Academy. Multiple award winner in extensions and lamination. Named Lash Queen at Italian Lash Legends 2026 and Vulcanic Live Competition 2026.

jenny-melacca.bio: Lash Love Academy graduate and award-winning lash artist. At Vulcanic Live 2026 she won first place and Best Work in One to One, Junior Brazilian Volume and Junior Soft Volume.

cornelia-elena-iacob.bio: UK-based makeup artist, CPD-accredited trainer and founder of ELN Glam Studio. She placed second at The Female Boss Awards 2026.

karine-habriielian.bio: Nail artist and educator based in San Diego with over 14 years of experience. Grand Prix winner at TEORA Beauty 2026 and a WBC Top 10 Nail Artist in 2026. She teaches advanced manicure, pedicure, nail sculpting and gel techniques.

ugne-cepaite.bio: Lash artist, educator and founder of LBU LASHES. Originally from Lithuania, she works in the Chicago area and has eight years of experience. She won the European Online Championship in 2020 and judged The Monte Carlo BEAUTY Championship in 2025.

cinthya-rodriguez.bio: Founder and CEO of CR LashXpert Academy with over 15 years in the beauty industry. Creator of the Latin Lift and Método Fusión techniques, she has trained over 200 professionals and judged more than 30 international championships.

legal.separateDocuments: Consent is separate from this policy, participation rules and marketing communications.
legal.checkbox: I consent to the processing of my personal data to review my application. *
legal.formHint: On submission, your data is sent to the organiser through Web3Forms. Details:

consent.title: Consent to personal data processing
consent.intro: I freely consent to the organiser of Beauty Dynastya identified below (the Controller) processing the data I submit through the application form. I give consent by separately selecting the checkbox and pressing the submit button.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.text: To receive and review my application as a participant, judge or speaker, identify my chosen role and organise the next steps relating to my application. Processing is limited to this purpose. This consent does not cover advertising or unrelated offers.

data.title: Data I provide
data.text: My first and last name, country and selected role. The application also includes the form language, consent confirmation, the consent version and document link, the policy link, and submission date and time. The form does not request identity documents, payment details, health or biometric data, and does not accept file uploads.

actions.title: Permitted operations
actions.text: Collection, recording, organisation, accumulation, storage, correction, retrieval, use, disclosure to parties delivering and processing the application, restriction, deletion and destruction. Processing may be automated or manual and is limited to what is necessary for the stated purpose.

processors.title: Recipients and service providers
processors.text: The form sends data to Web3Forms, a service operated by Web3Creative (India), which processes it and delivers it to the organiser by email using its infrastructure and sub-processors. Processing may take place in other countries. The service may also process request information, including an IP address, for delivery and spam prevention. Its infrastructure, transfer and retention terms are described in the linked documents. This consent does not replace the independent legal grounds and mandatory procedures required for international transfers.

term.title: Duration and retention
term.text: Consent lasts until the application review and related organisational steps are completed, or until withdrawal. Once the purpose has been fulfilled or consent withdrawn, data must be deleted or anonymised within the time limits of applicable law, unless another legal ground requires or permits further processing. Retention by the external processor is also governed by its terms. Web3Forms specifies a maximum of three years unless a plan or earlier deletion provides a shorter period.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawing consent
withdrawal.text: I may withdraw consent or request access, correction or deletion using the Controller's contacts above. My name, approximate application date and the nature of my request are sufficient to start; further information may be needed only to verify ownership of the data. Processing stops after withdrawal unless another independent legal ground applies. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing.

limits.title: Limits of this consent
limits.text: This consent does not authorise public disclosure of my name, photograph, competition entry or other data, marketing messages, processing of sensitive categories, or biometric identification. These require separate legal grounds and, where necessary, separate consent. Without selecting the checkbox, I cannot submit the form. Opening Telegram or Instagram does not itself give consent to processing through this form.

privacy.title: Personal data processing policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data the Beauty Dynastya website uses, why it is needed, how applications are submitted and how to contact us about your data. It provides information about processing and does not replace separate consent.

scope.title: Scope
scope.text: This policy covers browsing this website and submitting its application form as a participant, judge or speaker. It does not govern your independent activity on external websites or messaging services. Applications rely on consent and other grounds provided by applicable law; the specific rules depend on the Controller's place of activity and the circumstances of processing.

data.title: Application and technical data
data.text: The form collects first and last name, country and selected role. Submission adds the language, consent confirmation, document version and address, policy address, and submission date and time. Hosting and form delivery providers may receive IP addresses, browser and request information to operate and protect their infrastructure. The form does not request passwords, identity documents, payment details or health information.

purpose.title: Purposes and minimisation
purpose.text: Application data is used to review the application and organise steps relating to the selected role. Technical information supports delivery, availability and protection against abuse. Submitting an application does not give consent to advertising, public disclosure or independent marketing uses.

processing.title: Processors and transfers
processing.text: On submission, the browser sends the application directly over HTTPS to Web3Forms (Web3Creative, India), which delivers it to the organiser's email. Its published terms list AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner and other named sub-processors; processing may occur in several countries. Transfers and storage are also governed by Web3Forms documents. A checkbox does not remove applicable data localisation, processor contract or international transfer requirements.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.text: Application data is needed until review and related organisational steps are completed, or consent is withdrawn, unless another legal ground requires or permits further processing. Once the grounds end, data is deleted or anonymised within the time limits of applicable law. Web3Forms states a maximum retention of three years unless a plan or earlier deletion shortens it. Requests for deletion, including data held by processors, should be directed to the Controller.

rights.title: Your rights and requests
rights.text: You may request information about processing and access to your data, correction, restriction or deletion, and withdraw consent. Other rights, including portability and objection, may apply where the law provides for them. Send your request using the Controller's contacts above. If a concern remains unresolved, you may contact the competent supervisory authority or court under applicable law.

storage.title: Browser preferences
storage.text: The website uses localStorage key beauty-dynastya-language only to remember the selected language. Name, country and role remain in form state until successful submission or leaving the page and are not saved by the website in localStorage. The current source code contains no advertising pixels or analytics systems. Technical mechanisms of hosting and external services are governed by their own terms.

external.title: Messaging services and public content
external.text: Telegram and Instagram buttons open external services; application data is not automatically added to these links. Messages you send there independently are processed under the service's and recipient's rules. Publication of judge, speaker and participant profiles and materials requires an independent legal basis and is not covered by application consent. Changes to processing require updates to this policy and, where necessary, consent.
